scenes.stage_direction: The household's polished public account meets the records retained by its workers. Amara speaks for herself.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Kellan wanted Ethan hidden under a private custody arrangement. Victor turned it into a demand for money.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: They agreed about taking him. They didn't agree about what came after.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Now they are withholding information from each other.

metadata.evidence_summary: Kellan wanted concealed custody; Victor converted it into ransom.
